high_level_overview.overview: This JCL job, named **READXREF**, is designed to read a Cross-Reference (XREF) master file as part of the CardDemo application. It executes the program **CBACT03C**, which processes a VSAM Key-Sequenced Data Set (KSDS) containing card cross-reference data stored in **AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS**. The job's business purpose is to retrieve and report on credit card cross-reference records, likely linking card numbers to account or customer data, with all output directed to the system output log.

parameters.name: JOB
parameters.description: The job name that uniquely identifies this job to the system. It is used for tracking, scheduling, and referencing the job in the JES spool and system logs.

parameters.name: ACCOUNTING INFORMATION
parameters.description: The accounting information or job description string passed to the installation's accounting routines. It is used for job identification and billing/tracking purposes.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the job class (input class) that determines which job queue the job is placed in. Class A typically represents a general-purpose execution class, affecting scheduling priority and resource allocation.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class for the job log and system messages (JES message log). It determines where the job's system output messages are routed after job completion.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Specifies the TSO user ID to be notified when the job completes. The symbolic parameter &SYSUID resolves to the user ID of the person who submitted the job, sending them a completion notification message.

job_details.purpose: Reads the Cross-Reference (XREF) master VSAM KSDS file using the customer application program CBACT03C. This step retrieves and processes card cross-reference data stored in the VSAM dataset.
job_details.inputs: XREFFILE: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS (VSAM KSDS cross-reference master file)

data_operations.description: Load library accessed to load and execute program CBACT03C
VSAM KSDS cross-reference master file opened for reading by program CBACT03C via DD name XREFFILE
Program output written to system output via SYSOUT DD
Program print output written to system output via SYSPRINT DD
